com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface ITargetComponentPortSelector

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IAbstractComponentPortSelector, IComponentPortSelector, IElementSelector

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface ITargetComponentPortSelector
extends IComponentPortSelector
    The ITargetComponentPortSelector Api allows the definition of predicates for target component port selection. it mainly consists of the IComponentPortSelector Api but has enhancements for selecting target component ports for auto-mapping of ports.

    The predicates are combined via logical AND. To realize other combinations, use the IComponentPortSelector.or(groovy.lang.Closure<?>), IComponentPortSelector.not(groovy.lang.Closure<?>) and IComponentPortSelector.and(groovy.lang.Closure<?>) predicates.
